description: Provides a straightforward loading placeholders in your application. Modern alternative to generic loading spinners.

props.boilerplate: Remove the loading animation from the skeleton.
props.loading: Applies a loading animation with a on-hover loading cursor. A value of **false** will only work when there is content in the `default` slot.
props.loadingText: aria-label for the element in a loading state.
props.type: A string delimited list of skeleton components to create such as `type="text@3"` or `type="card, list-item"`. Will recursively generate a corresponding skeleton from the provided string. Also supports short-hand for multiple elements such as `article@3, paragraph@2`, which generates 3 article and 2 paragraph skeletons. See the [list of pre-defined types](/components/skeleton-loaders/#type). Use **ossein** for a plain block that fills the loader, a base for custom loading compositions.
props.types: A custom types object that will be combined with the pre-defined options (e.g. `{ product: 'image, heading, actions' }`). You can reuse a built-in name to replace the definition.
